scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:atelier
scripts.build:all: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @oyn/example-mui -w @oyn/example-shadcn && npm run build:atelier
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w oyn && npm run build -w @oyn/ui && npm run check:architecture
scripts.test:ceramic: npm run build:packages && node tests/ceramic-light.mjs && node tests/ceramic.mjs
scripts.test:ceramic-elevation: npm run build:packages && node tests/ceramic-elevation.mjs && node tests/ceramic-reflection.mjs && node tests/ceramic-continuity.mjs
scripts.test:ceramic-shadow: npm run build:packages && node tests/ceramic-shadow.mjs && node tests/ceramic-contact-composition.mjs
scripts.test:shadcn: node tests/shadcn-menus.mjs && node tests/shadcn-menu-variants.mjs && node tests/shadcn-navigation-motion.mjs && node tests/shadcn-navigation.mjs && node tests/shadcn-registry.mjs && node tests/shadcn-scroll.mjs && node tests/shadcn-scrollbar.mjs && node tests/shadcn-panel.mjs && node tests/shadcn-shadow-stacking.mjs && node tests/shadcn.mjs && node tests/tabs.mjs && node tests/surface-dialog.mjs
scripts.build:shadcn: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @oyn/example-shadcn
scripts.test:surface-appearance: npm run build:packages && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node tests/surface-appearance.mjs
scripts.test:webgl-fallback: npm run check:webgl-shaders && npm run build:packages && node tests/webgl-fallback.mjs
scripts.build:registry: rm -rf examples/atelier/public/r && shadcn build registry.json -o examples/atelier/public/r
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && node tests/ui-control.mjs && node tests/ui-items.mjs && node tests/atelier-tabs.mjs && node tests/ui-catalog-ssr.mjs && node tests/ui-catalog.mjs
scripts.test:ui-catalog: npm run build && node tests/ui-catalog-ssr.mjs && node tests/ui-catalog.mjs
scripts.build:site: npm run build:packages && vite build site --base ./
